stewards.name: OpenAI
stewards.role: Founding maintainer, TSC seat 1; runs ChatGPT, the main ACP agent surface.

stewards.name: Stripe
stewards.role: Founding maintainer, TSC seat 2; co-developer; Shared Payment Token is the first compatible Delegate Payment implementation.

implementers.name: ChatGPT product discovery (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Agent surface ingesting merchant feeds through ACP; Target, Sephora, Nordstrom, Lowe's, Best Buy, The Home Depot and Wayfair named on 2026-03-24.

implementers.name: ChatGPT apps external checkout (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Users finish on the merchant's own checkout; generally available.

implementers.name: ChatGPT payment sheet (OpenAI)
implementers.role: In-chat payment for select marketplace partners; PSPs Adyen, Checkout.com, Fiserv, PayPal, Stripe, Worldpay.

implementers.name: ChatGPT Instant Checkout, 2025 form (OpenAI)
implementers.role: In-chat ACP checkout launched with US Etsy sellers on 2025-09-29; scaled back in March 2026.

implementers.name: Stripe (Shared Payment Tokens, Agentic Commerce Suite)
implementers.role: Delegate Payment implementation and seller tooling for ACP or UCP.

implementers.name: PayPal
implementers.role: Announced it will adopt ACP and run an ACP server for its merchants; CLA signed 2026-04-16.

implementers.name: Microsoft Copilot Checkout
implementers.role: Launched 2026-01-08 saying it adopts open standards like ACP; later merchant page requires a UCP-compliant feed.

implementers.name: Walmart
implementers.role: Announced Instant Checkout plans on 2025-10-14; by 2026-03-24 described as a Walmart app in ChatGPT with its own payments.

implementers.name: Shopify (Shopify Catalog)
implementers.role: Product data reaches ChatGPT through Shopify Catalog; purchases complete on the merchant store.

implementers.name: Corporate CLA signatories (Adyen, Wix, commercetools, OpenCommerce Network, Affirm, Agentic Commerce Inc.)
implementers.role: Contributors under the CLA; signing is not evidence of a live integration.
